about: About a minute a frame as a screenshot in software, and twice the sharpness times out, so read the canvas. The page has no test hook: step the hash on one page and do not reload. p runs from the arrival (below 0) to 1. Hash keys: mode (vivo, vitro, infer), p, angle, irm, wl, focus, sub, cut, orbit.

sets.name: fusion
sets.note: The whole event in the cell. Expect: every protein stays in its membrane the same way up, nothing leaks before the pore opens, and the vesicle's lipid ends up in the cell membrane.
